# Data inventory and data dictionary

*Member A deliverable (data and modelling lead). Generated by `src/s17_member_a_pack.py` from the last pipeline run, so the figures match the code output exactly.*

## 3. Quality findings

10 quality issues were recorded automatically before any cleaning was applied. The most common categories were:

- **duplicate_rows** - 6 occurrences
- **high_missingness** - 2 occurrences
- **constant_column** - 2 occurrences

## 4. Cleaning actions

37 actions were logged. Every action records the dataset, what was done, why, and the row count before and after, so nothing changes silently.

| Dataset | Action | Detail | Reason |
|---|---|---|---|
| iot_fridge | strip_whitespace_bom | all object columns | raw files contain a BOM and padded values such as ' off ' |
| iot_fridge | drop_redundant_columns | date, time | both duplicate the information already held in ts |
| iot_fridge | standardise_category | temp_condition | case and spacing varied between records |
| iot_fridge | flag_exact_duplicates | 8901 rows flagged | identical ts and values; kept but flagged so models can exclude them without deleting evidence |
| iot_garage_door | strip_whitespace_bom | all object columns | raw files contain a BOM and padded values such as ' off ' |
| iot_garage_door | drop_redundant_columns | date, time | both duplicate the information already held in ts |
| iot_garage_door | coerce_numeric | sphone_signal: 35000 values to NaN | non-numeric text found in a measurement column |
| iot_garage_door | standardise_category | door_state | case and spacing varied between records |
| iot_garage_door | flag_exact_duplicates | 38836 rows flagged | identical ts and values; kept but flagged so models can exclude them without deleting evidence |
| iot_garage_door | retain_missing | sphone_signal: 35000 NaN | gaps are treated as missing telemetry, not imputed, so that the model cannot learn from invented readings |
| iot_gps_tracker | strip_whitespace_bom | all object columns | raw files contain a BOM and padded values such as ' off ' |
| iot_gps_tracker | drop_redundant_columns | date, time | both duplicate the information already held in ts |
| iot_gps_tracker | flag_exact_duplicates | 0 rows flagged | identical ts and values; kept but flagged so models can exclude them without deleting evidence |
| iot_modbus | strip_whitespace_bom | all object columns | raw files contain a BOM and padded values such as ' off ' |
| iot_modbus | drop_redundant_columns | date, time | both duplicate the information already held in ts |
| iot_modbus | flag_exact_duplicates | 19744 rows flagged | identical ts and values; kept but flagged so models can exclude them without deleting evidence |
| iot_motion_light | strip_whitespace_bom | all object columns | raw files contain a BOM and padded values such as ' off ' |
| iot_motion_light | drop_redundant_columns | date, time | both duplicate the information already held in ts |
| iot_motion_light | standardise_category | light_status | case and spacing varied between records |
| iot_motion_light | flag_exact_duplicates | 28629 rows flagged | identical ts and values; kept but flagged so models can exclude them without deleting evidence |
| iot_thermostat | strip_whitespace_bom | all object columns | raw files contain a BOM and padded values such as ' off ' |
| iot_thermostat | drop_redundant_columns | date, time | both duplicate the information already held in ts |
| iot_thermostat | flag_exact_duplicates | 1154 rows flagged | identical ts and values; kept but flagged so models can exclude them without deleting evidence |
| iot_weather | strip_whitespace_bom | all object columns | raw files contain a BOM and padded values such as ' off ' |
| iot_weather | drop_redundant_columns | date, time | both duplicate the information already held in ts |
| iot_weather | flag_exact_duplicates | 0 rows flagged | identical ts and values; kept but flagged so models can exclude them without deleting evidence |
| telemetry_events | unify_sensors | 784691 measurement rows | single long table lets every sensor be compared on one timeline |
| network_flow | strip_whitespace_bom | all object columns | consistent keys for grouping and joining |
| network_flow | placeholder_to_missing | 4385154 cells | Zeek uses '-' for not-applicable fields; treating it as a category would create fake patterns |
| network_flow | coerce_numeric | src_port, dst_port, duration, src_bytes, dst_bytes, missed_b | numeric fields arrive as text because of the '-' placeholder |
| network_flow | flag_sparse_columns | ssl_version, ssl_cipher, ssl_resumed, ssl_established, ssl_s | 16 columns are >97% missing; excluded from modelling features but retained in the file for investigation |
| network_flow | flag_exact_duplicates | 20569 rows | identical flows are plausible in a testbed; flagged rather than deleted |
| network_flow | feature_engineering | total_bytes, total_pkts, bytes_ratio, log_duration, log_tota | size and direction features are the standard way to separate scanning, flooding and data-transfer behaviour |
| access_log | parse_timestamps | 0 unparseable rows removed | time is the backbone of behaviour analytics |
| access_log | feature_engineering | hour, dow, is_weekend, is_out_of_hours, is_failure, is_exter | these are the behavioural dimensions used for the user baseline in step 7 |
| access_user_day | aggregate | 2792 user-day rows | behaviour analytics compares a user against their own daily history |
| network_flow | derive_ip_profile | 776 addresses profiled | ToN_IoT provides no asset names; roles are inferred from observed behaviour and the mining archetype column is |

## 5. Decisions a marker may want to question

- **Duplicates are flagged, not deleted, in the stored data.** The flag is used to exclude them from model training and testing, but the rows stay in the file so that no evidence is destroyed.
- **Missing telemetry values are not imputed.** A gap in a sensor feed is treated as a gap, because an invented reading would teach the model a pattern that never happened.
- **Zeek's `-` placeholder is treated as missing, not as a category.** Left as a string it would have become one of the strongest, and entirely artificial, predictors.
- **The ToN_IoT flow mirror has no timestamp column**, so joins to that source are made on address and asset rather than on time. This is recorded as defect D01.
